title: Best Custom AI Voice Creators (2026): Clone or Design a Voice
description: How to hire someone to create a custom AI voice or voice clone: consent, recording quality, rights, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Custom AI voice creators build a unique synthetic voice for your brand or clone a real person's voice with their permission. The voice can then read scripts for videos, apps, games or customer messages. Projects go wrong when consent is missing, training recordings are poor, or the voice could be misused. Voice cloning carries real risks, so this guide focuses on doing it legally, safely and with good quality.

faq.a: Only with the clear, written consent of the person whose voice it is. Never clone a voice without permission, including celebrities.
Clean recordings in a quiet room, read in the style you want. The amount depends on the tool and quality goal.
Agree on who owns the voice model, where it is stored and who can use it. The voice owner should be able to withdraw consent.

faq.q: Can the voice speak other languages?
faq.a: Some tools support this. Quality varies, so test with native speakers.
Limit access to the voice, keep records of use and choose tools with security features.
